Traffic Advisory Issued for Kingdom Pre-Release Event in Hyderabad

#Hyderabad: The Hyderabad Traffic Police have issued a traffic advisory ahead of the Kingdom movie pre-release event scheduled today, July 28, 2025, from 5 PM to 10 PM at Yousufguda Police Lines. 

Heavy public movement is expected around Kotla Vijaya Bhaskar Reddy (KVBR) Stadium. Traffic diversions will be in place at key junctions including Krishna Nagar, Yousufguda Basti, and Savera Function Hall. 

Commuters are advised to avoid the area and use alternate routes. Designated parking has been arranged at Janakamma Thota, Savera Function Hall, and Mahamood Function Hall. 

#Kingdom #HyderabadTraffic #TrafficAdvisory #HyderabadEvents #KVBRStadium #Yousufguda
